README.md:
# uploads-bare

A small upload service built on Cloudflare Workers, R2 and Workers AI.

## Endpoints

- `PUT /files/:name` — stores the request body as `:name` in R2. Requires a
  shared API key, sent either as `X-API-Key: <key>` or
  `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Responds with JSON containing a
  one-sentence AI-generated description of the uploaded content.
- `GET /files/:name` — returns the stored file body (no auth required),
  with the stored description available in the `X-Description` header.

## Setup

```
wrangler secret put API_KEY
wrangler r2 bucket create uploads-bare-files
wrangler deploy
```

Images are described with a vision model; text-like files (text/*, json,
xml, javascript, csv) are summarized by an LLM; everything else gets a
plausible description generated from its metadata.
